title: Video by earn.edits
description:
📊 Every time you buy something... you probably look at it without thinking. Those little black lines seem almost invisible 🛒

📼 This retro-style motion piece traces the barcode back to 1974, when a pack of chewing gum became the first product ever scanned. Product visualization, kinetic typography, and data-driven graphics rebuild the shift from manual pricing to a simple scan

🎞️ Built with that vintage throwback look — analog textures, retro typography, and cinematic transitions carrying the story checkout by checkout

⚡ Those little black lines aren’t just lines. They became the language of modern retail
